steps.name: A Certain Map (1)
steps.objective: First talk to [Arche] in 「Pneuma」, then find [Yuran] in 「Lumen Alliance Headquarters」.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Adventurer?
(Arche looks surprised to see %s standing before her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche, why are you so surprised?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's a secret... No, I mean... I thought you'd return someday, but not so soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I just wanted to come. Once I've visited a place, I tend to come back...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As for how I managed to get here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain to Arche how you were able to return to Pneuma.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I see. Lady Iris...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Did you have any... trouble on the way? Pain like your whole body was being torn apart, or a feeling of twisting out of existence?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait. Is it normally that painful?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's a secret, but... yes.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: When Lady Gaia brought me here to save my life, it hurt terribly.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: But you seem fine, Adventurer... Perhaps...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It must hurt less because the goddesses love you so much!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: After all that thought, that's your answer...?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Hehe. That's how I am.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Oh, right. There's something I'd like to ask of you. Is that all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A favor?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Please find an object. Something from the place you came from.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It seems to have drifted here when time and space shook recently. I've been trying to find it without any luck.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: If the spirits are affected strangely while searching for it, it could disrupt not only this place but the goddess' realm as well.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I would like you to find it, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll help. What is it?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I can't tell what form it has now. You'll need to ask the people you know what they've lost.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That sounds complicated.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The moment you discover what it is, it will reveal itself in the Domain of Time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But where should I go first...?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Try Lumen first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lumen?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Lady Iris' Inner World is nearby. I thought it might have drifted in from that direction.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh! Then I'll go ask.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Thank you, %s. Once you learn what it is, go to the domain where Chronos dwells.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Arche.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'll ask Yuran first. She knows Lumen better than anyone...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You're here. It's been a while. Thank you for helping my master. Thanks to you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, no. I only did what I should...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You said exactly what Lady Iris did.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, when was Iris here?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: She wasn't. She sent word through Zoe, the flower spirit. You really are no different, %s.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Surely you have no further business in Lumen? An outsider should have nothing left to do in Eastland.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As cold as ever...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It isn't Eastland's business. It's personal.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: ...Does it concern Lady Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Would you understand if I said yes?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Then I will cooperate. Go ahead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you seen anyone in Lumen searching for something they've lost recently?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: That's vague. Something lost... Ah. Ull may be looking for something. He's up in that tree. You can find him there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I'll go see Ull. Is he doing all right lately? You were very worried about him.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: He is fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I believe he is beyond what I should worry about. Whatever happens now is his responsibility. We will meet again if my master calls for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. See you later.

steps.name: A Certain Map (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Chronos] in 「Chronos's Time」 and obtain a <Map of a Certain Continent>. Go out to the dungeon's reward room and watch what happens, then turn in the quest to [Ull] in 「Lumen Alliance Headquarters」.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: What do you want?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not even a hello.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I don't think we need formal greetings... Don't make me ask again. Did my senior send you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I wanted to ask you something. Have you lost anything lately, or been looking for something?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: So that's why I couldn't find it no matter how hard I looked. It drifted into another world...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you saying it's my fault?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: No. It couldn't be helped. I don't think that badly of you.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: So you're going to find it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you tell me what it is, I think I can.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: You've reached that sort of world already.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: In that case, I'll ask you. Find it for me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what were you looking for?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: A map of other continents. It was kept at the alliance headquarters. The moment I took it out to examine it, it vanished from my hands.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why were you looking at it?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: You don't need to know. Now go find it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's with that attitude...?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: They say a sudden change in character means death is near. You'll spare yourself stress if you just go without complaining.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh... Fine. I have to do it anyway...
(Expecting no improvement in Ull's attitude, the adventurer leaves Lumen. Something enormous climbs the tree and appears before Ull.)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: What a noisy entrance.

lines.speaker: 베스카
lines.text: It can't be helped. With a body this size...

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Did you look for the gate?

lines.speaker: 베스카
lines.text: All traces of gates from Eastland to the Demon Realm have disappeared.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Even with Weiss gone, traces of the Demon Realm should remain... They weren't connected to him anyway...

lines.speaker: 베스카
lines.text: May I offer my opinion?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I suspect it's the same as mine...

lines.speaker: 베스카
lines.text: Yes... Someone in the Demon Realm must have intervened. Lux is one thing, but...

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Ah, Veska.

lines.speaker: 베스카
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Let's check as soon as we have the map. We'll visit that ancestral land you mentioned too. That should give us something to work with.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Welcome. Hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Chronos. Were you waiting here?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I sensed you coming and came to meet you. You heard what Arche said, hoot?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I found out what we're looking for.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: What is it? Hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A map of continents the people of Eastland haven't visited.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I see. Hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know where it is?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: About that... Hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why the hesitation?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: It seems to have drifted deeper than the space I originally occupied. There's a condition you must meet to go there. Hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, come on. Don't tell me... Surely not...

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Yes, exactly what you're thinking. Hoot. You must face me and receive 'permission.' Hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I know what you're thinking. Hoot. That place is formed from a will stronger than my own. Hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An ancient god...?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Perhaps. Perhaps not. Hoot.
(Chronos suddenly winks, despite his impassive expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why the sudden wink?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I'll wait at the entrance. Defeat me. Hoot. And I won't fall easily. Hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Chronos.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: See you there, %s.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Hooooooot!
(Chronos lets out a tremendous cry and flies into the sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I still can't get used to that cry. All right, let's focus and go.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Hoot...?
(Chronos stops moving, then withdraws.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chronos?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: The will you showed in facing me has been granted 'permission.' Hoot. You may take the object. Hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Crouch down and search the floor. Hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you sure that's all right?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: So suspicious. Hoot. Would you like me to chant a spell? Hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something like 'Hoot, hoot, hooooot'?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Something like that. How did you know, hoot?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Spirits really are all alike. No need for a spell. Ah!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can feel something. This is it!

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: That's indeed the object you're looking for. Hoot. May I see it for a moment, hoot?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're already holding it... Is there something you want to check?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: I want to see which continents it shows. Hoot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Let's see, let's see... Hmm. Jiendia here, Freios here, and Creta here—now Eastland. Hoooot.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: There are several others, but I know nothing about them. The goddess' power doesn't reach them, so no information comes to me. Hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Which means...

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Someday the gods' emissary will have to go and find out, hoot?

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: My domain was a little unsettled, but it seems stable again. One left now? Hoot?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know what else there is, but I should return this and come back to Pneuma.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: Then you'll meet Kairos. Hoot. There are no more foreign objects in this space. Hoot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Chronos. I'll be going.

lines.speaker: 크로노스
lines.text: It was good to see you. Hoot. I should get back to work too. Hoot.
(As Chronos takes flight, his lonely muttering drifts back on the wind.)

lines.speaker: 크로노스의 목소리
lines.text: I want a vacation. Hoot... I want to sleep like Kairos. Hoot...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Work must be rough. Oh, no time to stand around. Back to Ull.
(Ull gives a faint smile at the map in %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here. The map.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I won't bother acting surprised. It's hardly the first time you've done something like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I looked on the way back. This map shows other continents too?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Yes. Jiendia, Freios, Eastland... And several others.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: The names passed down to us are something like Taegis, Nagen, and Otros. I don't know if they're accurate.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Chronos had no information about them... Should I ask a little more?)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Freios is the only continent we have much contact with. Now go. You won't get answers by prying like that.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: No need to look surprised.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I don't know anything either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Goodbye, then. Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did you say?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Thank you. I don't know whether we'll meet again, but if we do, I hope we can work together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Huh? He's quite different from before... Is he going somewhere?)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, nothing. R-right... I have somewhere to get back to, so I'll go.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Heh.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Whew... That's one found. I should ask Arche where to go next.)
(As %s recedes into the distance, Ull stretches lightly.)

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I feel stiff today.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Time to prepare. Before I leave, I should apologize to Ell for that mistake. It's been bothering me.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Ull, what did you just say?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Ell? Why are you here...?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Our eldest senior sent me to fetch you. What mistake did you make?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I can't tell you.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Tell me, and I'll forgive you right away.

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I... accidentally stepped on it.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I can't hear you. What?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I stepped on the paper dragon you folded. W-wait. Ell...
(Ell, already cold in demeanor, fixes Ull with a rigid stare.)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Veska, you're nearby, aren't you? Hold him!

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: V-Veska! I'm your master. Listen to me! Oh, Yuran...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Our troublesome juniors are full of energy as ever, I see. Keeping Master and me waiting so long...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Master had other business and left ahead of us. You will explain yourselves to him later.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: There's no changing your lateness, so I won't dwell on it. Now, when did I last spar with you two...?
(Yuran gives Ull and Ell a radiant smile rarely seen on her face. Yet the broader it grows, the more terrified they become.)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: ...Yuran, anything but that...

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: I-I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: What have you done wrong? I simply want to see how our juniors' skills have improved.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'll fetch my sword. Stay right here. You know what happens if you disappoint me, don't you?

lines.speaker: 울
lines.text: Yes...
(Later, word spreads that, by Yuran's order, the Floating Island, Phantom Poison Mist Swamp, and Training Forest are temporarily closed to outside visitors and training.)

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Yuran, I'll wait here.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You're coming too.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: What?!
